label: Action
definition: A remediation, evidence-collection or condition-fulfilment task with owner, due date and closure criteria.

label: Architecture Snapshot
definition: A versioned, approved and immutable view of the architecture in scope at a point in time, against which assessments are performed.

label: Assessment
definition: One bounded assessment answering one decision question for one CapabilityInstance, scope and ArchitectureSnapshot.

label: Assessment Procedure
definition: The ordered method steps used to assess one control for one claim type, using canonical assessment methods.

label: Asset Instance
definition: An identifiable real-world item, service, procedure or resource provider represented where material (for example a switchboard, a CDU, a GPU node).

label: Assurance Decision
definition: The decision of the accountable authority: decision state, conditions, scope, validity period and lifecycle.

label: Assurance Program
definition: The programme within which assessments are planned and decisions issued: assurance level target, profile, cadence and authority.

label: Assurance Report
definition: The issued report carrying statements, scope, findings, UNKNOWNs, limitations, distribution and validity.

label: Assurance Statement
definition: The bounded, disclosed wording of an AssuranceDecision for a named audience, which cannot exceed the decision.

label: Baseline Issue
definition: Recorded conflict between pinned sources, with original values, status and resolution lineage.

label: Capability Instance
definition: A specific deployment of an AI capability bounded by ownership, location, architecture, capacity, criticality and obligations.

label: Capacity Assertion
definition: A conditioned claim about a capacity value: metric, unit, subject, operating state, environment, duration, derating, evidence date and confidence.

label: Component
definition: A constituent part of an asset represented where material.

label: Control
definition: One of the 360 AIDCF-007A normative controls: objective, requirement, criteria, evidence profile, procedure and gate mappings.

label: Control Assessment
definition: The result of assessing one control, for one claim type, in one scope: result code, confidence, evidence, method, assessor and lifecycle.

label: Control Domain
definition: One of the 15 AIDCF-007A control domains.

label: Control Family
definition: One of the 90 AIDCF-007A control families (six per domain).

label: Critical Gate
definition: One of the 15 non-compensating critical gates CG-01 to CG-15, with scope, criteria and evidence floor.

label: Decision Recommendation
definition: The decision state, conditions, ceilings and limitations proposed from gate results, UNKNOWNs and scores, before authority review.

label: Dependency
definition: A reified reliance of one entity on another entity, resource, condition or decision, with direction, strength, states and substitutability.

label: Distribution Control
definition: The classification-bound disclosure rule for a record, edge, package or report: permitted audiences, purpose, redaction and expiry.

label: Event
definition: An observed or reported occurrence (change, incident, test failure, evidence expiry) ingested for impact analysis.

label: Evidence Object
definition: A record or observation, with provenance and integrity, used to support, challenge or qualify an assertion.

label: Evidence Package
definition: A sealed, manifest-listed set of EvidenceObjects collected for an assessment or gate, with custody and integrity metadata.

label: Evidence Requirement
definition: The evidence a control or gate needs for a claim type: classes, quality and sufficiency floors, state and period coverage, independence.

label: Failure Mode
definition: The manner in which an entity fails to perform its function (for example pump seizure, breaker failure to trip, optic degradation).

label: Failure Scenario
definition: An ordered path from initiating source through propagation steps and safeguards to residual state and outcome effect, from a stated pre-state.

label: Fault Domain
definition: A set of entities expected to be affected together by a common cause of failure, with its boundary and blast radius.

label: Finding
definition: A documented deficiency against a stated criterion, with condition, cause, consequence, evidence and gate and score effect.

label: Gate Result
definition: The evaluated status of one CriticalGate in one assessment scope (PASS, FAIL, UNKNOWN, APPROVED_NA, NOT_ASSESSED) with its inputs.

label: Hazard
definition: A non-intentional source of potential harm (for example utility voltage sag, coolant leak, heatwave, battery thermal runaway).

label: Infrastructure System
definition: A coordinated set of assets and interfaces providing one or more functions (for example a CDU secondary loop, a UPS system, a scale-out fabric).

label: Integration Handoff
definition: A reviewed exchange of identity or findings between AIDCF and the AI Trust Graph, preserving each framework's ownership.

label: Interface
definition: A defined point or mechanism of exchange between entities (electrical, thermal, fluid, network, management, data, physical, operational, provider).

label: Location
definition: A site, building, hall, room, row, rack position or logical placement.

label: Migration Record
definition: The record of converting data between versions or vocabularies: source, target, rule, mapping, exceptions and validation.

label: Operating State
definition: A defined condition of operation (NORMAL, DEGRADED, MAINTENANCE, EMERGENCY, RECOVERY, TRANSITION, SHUTDOWN, FAILED, UNKNOWN).

label: Party Entity
definition: An organisation, role, actor or team.

label: Reassessment Trigger
definition: A declared rule describing which events or conditions require reassessment of which records.

label: Release Manifest
definition: Signed, immutable bill of materials pinning every artifact, registry, vocabulary, schema and ontology version of one release.

label: Required Function
definition: A function whose loss or degradation materially affects one or more ServiceOutcomes (for example "remove 100% of rack heat at design inlet temperature").

label: Resource
definition: A consumable or constrained input required for operation (electrical capacity, cooling capacity, water, fuel, rack space, accelerator hours).

label: Review Record
definition: A recorded human review or approval: reviewer, authority, independence, scope reviewed, outcome and date.

label: Safeguard
definition: A real-world measure that prevents, detects, contains, corrects or recovers from a failure, threat or hazard.

label: Sample
definition: A defined selection of population items examined by a procedure, with population, selection method and size rationale.

label: Score Snapshot
definition: An immutable, reproducible computation of control, family and domain scores, coverage and band from pinned inputs and profile.

label: Service Outcome
definition: A measurable or assessable result the CapabilityInstance must achieve, with tolerance, duration and operating-state conditions.

label: Test Record
definition: The record of an authorised test or scenario exercise: authority, preconditions, safety controls, steps, observations and outcome.

label: Threat
definition: An actor-driven or intentional source of potential harm (for example unauthorised remote command of a cooling controller).

label: UNKNOWN Record
definition: A material fact that cannot be determined, with type (U1–U10), severity (US1–US5), reason, decision effect, evidence needed and owner.

label: Validation Result
definition: The outcome of a structural, semantic or business-rule validation of a record or package against a pinned release.
